evidence: Adds unit tests in src/wallet/test/coinselector_tests.cpp verifying GenerateChangeTarget in wallet coin selection.
rationale: Adds unit test coverage for change target randomization used to protect transaction privacy in coin selection. As noted in the PR description, 'This function has no unit test at all. You could widen the range, or make it not random anymore, and every test would still pass', making this a worthwhile preventative test against regressions.
